purpose: Prevent tools from being recommended when native Codex is clearer, safer, and sufficient.

rules.native_first_reason: Writing a prompt is text generation; a tool does not improve the requested result.
rules.escalate_when: The user asks to directly generate, edit, or batch-process media.

rules.native_first_reason: A pasted or local code snippet can be fixed with native coding ability.
rules.escalate_when: The user needs Codex to read or modify a real repository, commit, open a PR, review CI, or manage an issue.

rules.native_first_reason: Codex can build a small static page without Figma, deployment, or a complex framework.
rules.escalate_when: A real Figma source, hosting action, existing repository, or visual-browser QA is required.

rules.native_first_reason: Language work on provided text does not need connected account access.
rules.escalate_when: The user needs to read, reply to, or send a real email or edit a real document.

rules.native_first_reason: Codex can inspect small pasted data directly.
rules.escalate_when: The task requires a real Excel file, complex charts, saved workbooks, formatting preservation, or recurring analysis.

rules.native_first_reason: A prompt is text; image generation is not needed until the user wants an actual image result.
rules.escalate_when: The user asks to generate, edit, or batch-process images.

rules.native_first_reason: Planning and idea analysis can start with the information already in the conversation.
rules.escalate_when: The answer needs current market research, competitor evidence, or the user's private sources.

rules.native_first_reason: Give a method first; recommending tools before understanding the action is premature.
rules.escalate_when: The user asks Codex to carry out an action in a real external system.
